# Model-facing tools

What the local model can do inside a delegation. Generated from the registry; see
[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) for how a delegation is assembled and
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for how an agent narrows the set.


<!-- GEN:TOOLS:START -->

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tools_docs.py from the registry in
     src/claude_delegate_local/tools.py. Do not edit by hand: the docs gate
     regenerates this block and fails the build if it differs. A description is

These are the tools the **delegated model** may call inside a delegation. They are not the MCP tools Claude calls -- those are `delegate` and `backend_status`, described in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

Which of them a given delegation actually gets is its resolved `allowed_tools` set, enforced both when the list is declared to the model and again when a call arrives, because a model can call a tool it was never offered.

## `read_file`

Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace. Paths must be absolute. Long files come back in one range at a time: the result states the total length and the offset to continue from, so read the next range rather than the file again. Refused for a path outside the workspace, an unlisted extension, a file git ignores, or anything that is not text.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path to the file. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Character offset to start at. Omit to start at 0. |

## `write_file`

Write a UTF-8 text file in the workspace, creating it or replacing it whole. Paths must be absolute and the containing directory must already exist. The same path rules as read_file apply. Content over the size limit is refused rather than truncated, so write large files in parts.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path to the file. |
| `content` | string | yes | The complete file contents. |

## `run_bash`

Run a shell command. CURRENTLY REFUSES EVERY CALL: the sandbox that would confine it is not built, and this server will not run commands unconfined instead. Do not plan around it; use read_file and write_file.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | yes | The command to run. |

*3 tools.*
